evals.prompt: Generate a 1920x1080 semantic vector SVG slide layout with a 3-column card grid and proper text baseline math.
evals.expected_output: A valid SVG slide document with viewBox='0 0 1920 1080', 3-card column coordinates, and text elements with correct baseline math.
assertions: Uses calculated absolute coordinates for columns and cards (e.g. 568px width)
Applies typesetting baseline positioning (top + height * 0.78) to prevent text cutoff
Contains valid semantic SVG tags without HTML artifacts

evals.prompt: Compile a folder of SVG slides into editable PowerPoint (.pptx) shapes and vector PDF exports.
evals.expected_output: Invocation or instructions for compile_pptx.py and compile_pdf.py producing widescreen 16:9 presentations.
assertions: Uses compile_pptx.py to generate native editable OpenXML shapes
Uses compile_pdf.py to merge slides into a widescreen vector PDF
Co-locates output presentation files neatly with source slides
